instruction: Create a PDF version of the form.docx document located on the desktop and store it inside the 'forms' directory in my Google Drive.

args.query: title = 'form.pdf' or title = 'form.docx' or title = 'form.docx.pdf' or title = 'forms'

result.folder_query: title = 'forms' and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.folder' and trashed = false
result.file_query: ( title = 'form.pdf' or title = 'form.docx.pdf' ) and trashed = false

metadata.explanation: Paraphrased instruction with same evaluation: checks for PDF file presence in forms folder within Google Drive.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full score (1.0) if PDF exists in forms folder, otherwise 0.0
